digest.component_or_area: pytest fixtures and test environment handling
propositions: Seven decorated pytest fixtures return complete dict(os.environ) copies which expose arbitrary ambient credentials when pytest renders fixture arguments in long tracebacks via saferepr
Fixture-returned environment dictionaries remain mutable to support per-test overrides while an explicit allowlist approach prevents unrelated ambient secrets from entering rendered output
Each of the seven fixtures must carry only necessary variables (fake-bin-first PATH plus harness-declared state/path settings) rather than complete ambient inheritance
Minimal-environment test runs (env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin) pass all fixture consumers, proving no behavioral dependency on arbitrary ambient key presence

A deterministic RED oracle using synthetic sentinels confirms credential leakage occurs under default long traceback but not short traceback, and is eliminated by replacing broad dict(os.environ) with explicit allowlisted mappings
The fix preserves test mutability (HEALTH_TIMEOUT, observability offsets, fake-acli-first PATH) while removing the credential exposure surface at decorated fixture return boundaries
